slides.say: This project asks whether an optimized portfolio of NVIDIA, Microsoft, TSM and Qualcomm is ready for investment use. I use my earlier portfolio results as a retrospective Edition A baseline. The starting allocation was mostly Microsoft and TSM, and the position was a provisional pilot with monitoring. But there was already a warning: changing the estimation window moved one asset's weight by twenty percentage points. The apparently stable TSM stress did not resolve that concern.

slides.say: Edition B adds a rolling comparison with equal weight and inverse volatility, using the same stocks, evaluation months and trading-cost assumptions. This table changed my recommendation. The optimized portfolio returned twenty-four point eight-five percent cumulatively, while equal weight returned seventy point nine-seven percent. The optimized portfolio also had higher realized volatility and a larger drawdown. I therefore moved from a provisional pilot position to no capital deployment and further paper research only.

The original prediction was preserved. Larger target changes and more volatile realized returns are different measures.
slides.say: My changed-input prediction was only partly supported. Shortening the window to twenty-four months increased the largest quarterly target change from twenty to twenty-five percentage points. But realized net volatility fell from twenty-nine point six-one to twenty-seven point eight-three percent, so my volatility prediction was wrong. This taught me to separate allocation instability from realized risk. The result does not establish a durable improvement, and my recommendation remains unchanged.

slides.title: Committee decision
slides.html:
Do not deploy capital in the current process.

Authorize further paper research only.

  • User: committee evaluating a thematic research sleeve.
  • Universe: NVDA, MSFT, TSM and QCOM.
  • Same-universe equal weight is the primary comparison.
  • This does not establish a suitable whole-client allocation.
slides.say: My recommendation is not to deploy capital in the current optimized portfolio process. I am asking the committee to authorize further paper research only. The study concerns a four-stock thematic sleeve containing NVIDIA, Microsoft, TSM and Qualcomm. It evaluates whether the optimization process adds value relative to simple allocations. It does not establish a suitable portfolio for a client's entire wealth.
slides.point: Keep this screen visible for your opening. Point to the recommendation, then the universe. No other file needs to be open.

slides.html:

Equal weight70.97%27.79%-14.59%
Inverse volatility62.16%27.14%-16.62%

October 2024–September 2026 · 24 replay months · 10 bps one-way cost · initial purchase included

The optimized process earned less and realized more volatility in this replay.
slides.say: The comparison uses the same four stocks, the same twenty-four evaluation months and the same ten-basis-point one-way cost assumption, including initial purchase. The optimized portfolio returned twenty-four point eight-five percent cumulatively, compared with seventy point nine-seven percent for equal weight. Its annualized net volatility was twenty-nine point six-one percent, versus twenty-seven point seven-nine percent for equal weight. Its month-end maximum drawdown was also larger. These results do not support adoption of the optimizer merely because it minimizes an estimated risk measure.
slides.point: Point to the optimized and equal-weight rows. Move from return to volatility to drawdown while speaking. Do not call cumulative return annual.

slides.title: Concentration and estimation sensitivity
slides.html:
95%Largest starting position in the original replay
61.04%Largest starting position in the 50%-target-cap case
  • The 50%-target-cap case returned 33.84% net and still trailed equal weight.
  • A target cap does not control subsequent market drift.
  • Changing the estimation window can materially change allocations.

Separate research scenarios. None establishes a client-approved continuous concentration policy.
slides.say: The concern is not just lower return. The original candidate reaches a ninety-five percent position at a replay boundary. A separate fifty percent target-cap scenario improves cumulative return to thirty-three point eight-four percent, but still trails equal weight. Its largest starting position later reaches about sixty-one percent because holdings drift between trades. This illustrates why the committee needs an explicit concentration policy and why a historical covariance estimate should not be treated as a stable description of future risk.
slides.point: Point to 95%, then the drifted 61.04% figure. Explain target versus actual holdings; no app expander needs to be found.

slides.title: The limits affect the action
slides.html:
• The candidate trails equal weight in both 12-month segments.
  • Monitoring diagnostics flag one target event and nine volatility months.
  • The data was previously inspected; this is not an untouched holdout.
  • Historical adjustments and idealized execution limit investability claims.
  • A historical volume proxy does not establish live capacity.

The descriptive uncertainty interval includes zero for the annualized mean-return difference. No prospective superiority is established.
slides.say: Additional checks reinforce caution. The candidate trails equal weight in both twelve-month subperiods, and the monitoring diagnostics show breaches. The data had already been inspected, so this is a chronological replay rather than an untouched holdout. Price adjustments are retrospective and execution is idealized. The descriptive uncertainty interval includes zero for the mean-return difference. The historical volume proxy also cannot establish live capacity. These limits restrict the action; passing code tests does not make the investment case acceptable.

slides.title: Conditions for further research
slides.html:
Research analyst

  • Review quarterly.
  • Quarantine on provenance failure or infeasibility.
  • Quarantine above 15 pp target movement.
  • Quarantine above 22% trailing annualized net volatility.

Committee

  • Require a frozen prospective paper design.
  • Review a proposed 12 months of evidence.
  • Require suitable constraints and independent review.
  • Require credible execution, costs and capacity evidence.

No live pilot has occurred. Positive paper results would not automatically authorize capital.
slides.say: The research analyst should review the paper process quarterly and quarantine it on missing provenance, infeasibility, excessive target movement or trailing-volatility breaches. The accepted thresholds are fifteen percentage points and twenty-two percent, using the defined monitoring windows. The prospective proposal fixes the rules and a later execution buffer before observing new outcomes, with a proposed twelve-month evaluation. No pilot has begun. Reopening capital consideration requires a suitable mandate, independent review and credible implementation evidence. The immediate committee action remains further evidence gathering, not deployment.
slides.point: Point to the analyst responsibilities, then committee conditions. Deliver the final sentence and stop the recorder. Video 3 is finished.
